products.name: BIFFI PESTO
pros: High basil content (22%) for authentic flavor
Uses natural olive oil and pine nuts for quality texture
Contains natural preservatives (lisozima, sorbato di potassio) instead of artificial additives

products.name: RIO MARE PESTO AL TONNO CON BASILICO E PINOLI
pros: Includes tuna for added protein and savory depth
Basil and pine nuts provide classic pesto taste
Low fat content (32g per 100g) compared to traditional pesto
